modelRoutes.gatewayMultipleModelsDesc: One local relay provider can contain multiple public models.
modelRoutes.testCreateFailed: Unable to create the route test

gatewayIssue.gateway_key_missing: Local gateway is missing its independent API key
gatewayIssue.gateway_non_loopback_host: Local gateway requires a loopback listen address
gatewayIssue.gateway_disabled: Local gateway was turned off (could not create an API key)

modelRoutes.providerDesc: One provider serves multiple public models, each with independent route targets and load strategy.
modelRoutes.exposeProviderModelsDesc: When on, local apps holding the gateway key can call your API-key providers as provider/model and consume their quota. Subscription and OAuth accounts are never exposed.
modelRoutes.runtimeUnavailableHint: Local settings are unaffected and will sync automatically when Kun starts.
modelRoutes.apiCompatibilityDesc: Compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages. Public model IDs come from the routed models below.
modelRoutes.copyCurlUnavailable: Enable at least one route with an enabled target before copying an example.
modelRoutes.choosePool: Select a model to configure its target pool.
modelRoutes.hotUpdateHint: Saved configuration hot-updates the active Kun Runtime.
modelRoutes.publicModelIdDuplicate: Public model ID {{modelId}} is already used by another route.
modelRoutes.routeTargetsHint: Enable the targets that may receive requests. Drag or use the arrows to set priority.
modelRoutes.addTargetUnavailable: Add a provider with at least one model before adding a route target.
modelRoutes.weightInactive: Weight is only used by weighted round robin.
modelRoutes.providerMissingWarning: Provider {{providerId}} no longer exists. The reference was preserved; choose a replacement provider or delete this target.
modelRoutes.modelMissingWarning: Model {{modelId}} is no longer available from {{providerId}}. The reference was preserved; choose a replacement model or delete this target.
modelRoutes.confirmDeleteModel: Delete routed model {{modelId}} and all of its targets?
modelRoutes.failoverStatusesInvalid: Use comma- or space-separated HTTP status codes from 400 to 599.
modelRoutes.afterStreamNoRetry: After streaming output begins, the request stops in place and will not retry or execute tools again.
modelRoutes.routeValidationDesc: Kun Runtime runs tests asynchronously. They continue after you leave and restore progress and results when you return.
modelRoutes.blockedSaveFailed: Local save failed. Retry the save first; unsaved configuration is not used for route tests.
modelRoutes.blockedSaving: Configuration is being saved locally. Testing is available after saving and Kun Runtime sync complete.
modelRoutes.blockedInvalidTargets: This route has {{count}} invalid references and no executable target. Replace the provider or model first.
modelRoutes.blockedNoTargets: This route has no enabled valid targets. Add or enable a target first.
modelRoutes.blockedSyncFailed: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime sync failed. Check the Runtime logs and retry saving.
modelRoutes.blockedSyncFailedWithMessage: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime sync failed. {{message}}
modelRoutes.blockedRuntimeUnavailable: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime is unavailable and will sync automatically after startup.
modelRoutes.blockedRuntimeUnavailableWithMessage: Local configuration was saved, but Kun Runtime is unavailable and will sync automatically after startup. {{message}}
modelRoutes.blockedWaitingForSync: Local configuration was saved and is waiting for Kun Runtime to apply the same route pools and local API state.
modelRoutes.blockedRuntimeNotReady: Kun Runtime is not ready to test this complete route yet.
modelRoutes.apiDialogDesc: OpenAI-compatible endpoints for local processes only; no Authorization header is required.
modelRoutes.prerequisitesDesc: Enable the local API and at least one routed model. Use its public model ID in the request's model field.
modelRoutes.apiSecurityWarning: This relay is not a public API service. It binds only to the local loopback address and currently has no authentication. Do not expose it to a LAN or the internet through port forwarding or an unprotected reverse proxy.
modelRoutes.guideModelsDesc: Lists all enabled routed models in the local relay. Each returned data[].id is the public model ID used by generation requests.
modelRoutes.guideModelsEnabledOnly: Only enabled routed models are returned; disabled or invalid pools are omitted.
modelRoutes.guideModelsResponse: A successful response uses the OpenAI-style object: "list" and a data array.
modelRoutes.guideModelsDisabled: Returns 404 (gateway_disabled) when the local API is disabled.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesDesc: Generates content in the OpenAI Responses format for clients that send input as a single request value.
modelRoutes.guideFieldModel: model: Required. Use a public model ID such as {{modelId}}.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesInput: input: Required. Accepts a string or message array.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesStream: stream: Optional. true returns Server-Sent Events.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesOptional: max_output_tokens, tools, and reasoning_effort are optional.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesNonStreaming: A non-streaming response uses object: "response" with text in output.
modelRoutes.guideResponsesStreaming: A streaming response emits response.created, response.output_text.delta, and response.completed in order.
modelRoutes.guideChatDesc: Generates a conversation response in the OpenAI Chat Completions format used by most OpenAI-compatible SDKs.
modelRoutes.guideChatMessages: messages: Required and non-empty. Supports system, developer, user, assistant, and tool messages.
modelRoutes.guideChatStream: stream: Optional. true returns SSE; false returns complete JSON.
modelRoutes.guideChatTools: tools: Optional. Uses OpenAI function tool definitions; images accept Base64 data URLs only.
modelRoutes.exampleResponsesPrompt: Introduce the Kun local gateway in one sentence.
modelRoutes.targetNativeOnly: This account is available only through its native Agent, not as a gateway model API.
modelRoutes.stableAliasHint: Clients keep the same alias. Account and model changes apply to new requests; in-flight requests keep their route.
